# Test fixture licence

`face_astronaut.jpg` is the portrait of NASA astronaut Eileen Collins (NASA photo, 1992).
It is a work of the United States federal government and is in the public domain.
Source: scikit-image `skimage/data/astronaut.png` at tag v0.24.0, re-encoded as JPEG quality 88.

It is the only face image committed to this repository. It is used for unit tests and to
generate the fake gate video (`scripts/make_fixture_video.py`). It is never a customer and is
never stored by the hub at runtime.
